messages:
maya: Quick preflight — we have the launch post, benchmark landing, and webinar page going live next Wed. Need a short checklist for: keywords + meta, schema (benchmark + webinar), internal linking map, and redirects (old blog -> new canonical). Also inbound lead routing (HubSpot forms) mapping. Who can own?

jordan: I can own redirects + internal linking map. I put a starter sheet: https://tiny.redwood/launch-url-playbook (has URL list + desired canonical). Can someone confirm canonical decisions? :thumbsup:

sam: Redirects — prefer 301s at the CDN edge. Example rule for Fastly/Netlify edge:
```
# redirect old benchmark to new landing
if (req.url == "/benchmarks/2023/latency-vs-cost") {
  return redirect("https://redwood.com/benchmarks/latency-cost-2024", 301);
}
```
Also map parameter strips: drop `utm_*` and `ref` via normalized canonical.

olivia: I can do schema + meta. For the benchmark landing we should include:
- JSON-LD Dataset + SoftwareApplication (for the benchmark harness)
- HowTo or Results schema for the methodology summary
For the webinar page: WebinarEvent + FAQ + Speakership as Person. Quick example canonical and structured data snippet for WebinarEvent:
```html
<link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://redwood.com/webinars/launch-inference-ops\">
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{
  "@context":"https://schema.org",
  "@type":"Event",
  "name":"Inference Ops: Launch playbook",
  "startDate":"2024-05-12T17:00:00Z",
  "location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinars/launch-inference-ops"}
}</script>
```
Make sure `mainEntity` for FAQ points to questions used in promo tweets.

maya: @jordan awesome, can you also add the internal linking priority (hero CTAs -> benchmark -> docs -> signup)? Need to ensure the webinar CTA surfaces on the benchmark page.

jordan: Yep. Plan to add link graph: hero (score) -> benchmark deep dive -> compare table -> webinar CTA -> signup. Will also mark redirect exceptions (old canonical that must 301->new).

sam: For HubSpot: ensure forms post to the right pipeline, and use querystring mapping for campaign param. Quick mapping: `form_id=webinar-05` -> HubSpot form GUID `abc-123`, property `lead_source: webinar_launch`. I'll drop a fragment in the sheet.

olivia: SEO meta quick checklist:
- Title template: {Topic} — Redwood Inference (50-60 chars)
- Meta description <= 155 chars, include primary keyword + CTA
- OpenGraph images sized 1200x630, include event date for webinars
- Structured data validated in Rich Results test before push

seo-bot: Automated scan complete for staging URL https://staging.redwood.com/benchmarks/latency-cost-2024 — issues: missing WebinarEvent schema on linked webinar CTA page; 3 broken internal links; canonical tag present but points to host without https. Full report: https://ci.reports/redwood/scan/1718001234

maya: Thanks — @olivia please fix the WebinarEvent on the CTA page, @jordan fix the 3 broken links and canonical protocol. @sam confirm HubSpot GUID in sheet by EOD. I'll own the final QA + publish window.

jordan: Will do, assigning in the sheet. Also added a snippet for netlify _redirects for one-off pages: `"/old-url  /new-url  301!"` (force).

sam: Confirmed HubSpot GUID `abc-123` and pipeline mapping in the sheet. Also flagged one form that needs a hidden `campaign` field.

olivia: Fixed schema snippet and re-run local validator — all green. Pushed markup to staging branch `marketing/webinar-schema-fix`.

maya: Great progress. Final checklist for tomorrow's sync: staging QA pass, rich results validation, redirect deploy to edge, and HubSpot webhook test. If all good, we go live Wed 10:00 PT. :rocket:
